title: Interpretable Synthetic Medical Tabular Data Generation for Clinical Decision Support Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
abstract: arXiv:2610.00391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic medical tabular data generation has become essential for developing and validating computer-based medical systems (CBMSs) when real clinical data is restricted due to privacy, ethical, or data availability limitations. Existing probabilistic and deep generative models often lack interpretability and fail to preserve clinically meaningful dependencies, limiting their suitability for safety-critical applications. This paper proposes a novel application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) in a framework for synthetic medical tabular data generation with explicit causality and privacy preservation. Clinical features are described using linguistically interpretable fuzzy sets, and inter-feature dependencies are encoded as FCM edge weights computed from fuzzy set intersections. Synthetic patient records are generated by propagating randomly initialized linguistic activation vectors through the FCM until convergence, followed by defuzzif

translated_title: 基于模糊认知图的可解释合成医学表格数据生成方法用于临床决策支持
translated_abstract: 当真实临床数据因隐私、伦理或数据可用性限制而无法获取时，合成医学表格数据生成对于开发和验证基于计算机的医学系统（CBMS）变得至关重要。现有的概率模型和深度生成模型通常缺乏可解释性，并且无法保留具有临床意义的依赖关系，限制了其在安全关键应用中的适用性。本文提出了一种将模糊认知图（FCM）新颖应用于具有显式因果关系和隐私保护的合成医学表格数据生成框架。临床特征使用语言学上可解释的模糊集进行描述，特征间的依赖关系被编码为基于模糊集交集计算得到的FCM边权重。合成患者记录通过将随机初始化的语言激活向量在FCM中传播直至收敛来生成，随后进行去模糊化处理。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模糊认知图（FCM）的新颖框架，利用语言学可解释的模糊集和显式因果关系编码来生成具有隐私保护能力的合成医学表格数据，从而支持临床决策系统在数据受限情况下的开发与验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) to generate interpretable synthetic medical tabular data with explicit causality and privacy preservation, enabling the development and validation of clinical decision support systems under data access restrictions.
